content: Standard SaaS deletion lifecycle is two-phase: (1) soft delete sets deleted_at + deletion_scheduled_for (commonly 30 days out), data hidden from app but recoverable; (2) scheduled job hard-deletes records past deletion_scheduled_for. Retention split by data class: account/PII data purged at grace-period end (30-90 days); billing/financial records retained 5-7 years per tax law overriding privacy minimization. Practical policy: soft delete for accidental-recovery window, hard delete triggered for legal/privacy purge.
